name: Lynyrd Skynyrd

whyMatters.en: Jacksonville three-guitar Southern hard-rock: Free Bird and Sweet Home Alabama fixed dual/triple lead grammar and slide/country riff into 1970s FM hard-rock, not blues revival alone.
whyMatters.zh: 杰克逊维尔三吉他南方 hard-rock：Free Bird 与 Sweet Home Alabama 把双/三主音语法和 slide/country riff 钉进 1970 年代 FM hard-rock，不只是蓝调复兴。

lyricQuotes: If I leave here tomorrow / Would you still remember me
Sweet home Alabama / Where the skies are so blue

shortBio.en: Southern three-guitar hard-rock; Free Bird solo stack and Sweet Home Alabama riff as 70s FM staples.
shortBio.zh: 南方三吉他 hard-rock；Free Bird 叠 solo 与 Sweet Home Alabama riff 作 70 年代 FM 常备。

body.en:
Roots in Jacksonville high-school bands (My Backyard, etc.), name locked mid-60s after gym teacher Leonard Skinner. Pronounced (Pronounced 'Lĕh-'nérd 'Skin-'nérd) (1973) and Second Helping (1974) document the classic attack: Van Zant vocal, Rossington/Collins/(King) triple guitar, Powell piano fills.

Free Bird builds from organ/piano ballad into extended dual-lead solo section—hard-rock concert climax template. Sweet Home Alabama answers Neil Young with open-G riff and gang vocal. 1977 plane crash ends the original peak; Street Survivors is the last studio document with Van Zant/Gaines.
body.zh:
根在杰克逊维尔高中乐队（My Backyard 等），60 年代中期因体育老师 Leonard Skinner 定名。Pronounced（1973）与 Second Helping（1974）记录经典攻击：Van Zant 人声、Rossington/Collins/(King) 三吉他、Powell 钢琴填充。

Free Bird 从风琴/钢琴谣曲推到延长双主音 solo——hard-rock 演唱会高潮模板。Sweet Home Alabama 用 open-G riff 与合唱人声回应 Neil Young。1977 空难结束原班巅峰；Street Survivors 是 Van Zant/Gaines 最后录音室文献。

note.en: Ballad-to-dual-lead climax; piano intro then stacked guitar solos.
note.zh: 谣曲到双主音高潮；钢琴 intro 后叠吉他 solo。

note.en: Open-G riff + three-guitar weave; Second Helping FM staple.
note.zh: Open-G riff + 三吉他编织；Second Helping FM 常备。

note.en: Street Survivors warning track; Gaines era three-guitar density.
note.zh: Street Survivors 警告曲；Gaines 期三吉他密度。

body.en:
Skynyrd stack Les Paul/SG tones in interlocking rhythm and dual lead—closer to Allman Brothers twin-guitar logic, louder and more FM-hook driven.

Free Bird and Sweet Home Alabama are the two citation poles: epic solo architecture vs. three-chord regional anthem.

Van Zant writes plainspoken verses; Powell’s piano is the Southern hard-rock tell.
body.zh:
Skynyrd 用 Les Paul/SG 音色叠节奏与双主音——接近 Allman Brothers 双吉他逻辑，更响、更 FM 钩子驱动。

Free Bird 与 Sweet Home Alabama 是两个引用极：史诗 solo 结构 vs 三和弦地域颂歌。

Van Zant 写直白话主歌；Powell 钢琴是南方 hard-rock 识别点。

title.zh: King 到 Gaines 三吉他巅峰

body.en:
Ed King completes the three-guitar Second Helping era; Steve Gaines joins 1976 for Street Survivors polish.

Artimus Pyle replaces Bob Burns mid-decade. Core writers: Van Zant with Collins/Rossington.

1977 crash kills Van Zant, Gaines, Cassie Gaines; peak lineup ends there.
body.zh:
Ed King 补齐 Second Helping 三吉他；Steve Gaines 1976 年加入 Street Survivors 抛光。

十年中期 Artimus Pyle 替换 Bob Burns。核心写作：Van Zant 与 Collins/Rossington。

1977 空难夺走 Van Zant、Gaines、Cassie Gaines；巅峰阵容止于此。

title.zh: FM 南方 hard-rock 模板

body.en:
Guns N' Roses and later Southern/hard-rock acts cite the three-guitar weave and Free Bird climax structure.

Sweet Home Alabama remains a riff-teaching track; Free Bird a live-length endurance reference.

Scene debt is US FM hard-rock and country-rock cross, not British metal.
body.zh:
Guns N' Roses 与后来南方/hard-rock 乐队引用三吉他编织与 Free Bird 高潮结构。

Sweet Home Alabama 仍是 riff 教材曲；Free Bird 是现场时长耐力参照。

场景债务在美国 FM hard-rock 与 country-rock 交叉，非英国金属。
